decisions.statement: A landing that committed is taken as landed whatever went wrong after it.
What went wrong after that commit is said on stderr.
The arguments an apply takes are read here rather than by the command naming the apply.
The report an apply answers with is shaped here.
The message saying no edits are kept is worded here rather than by a command.
That message read by a subagent names the seat its draft went to and the call taking it back.
An apply given no message says the act and the paths that apply lands.
That message is composed by the rule every other landing composes by.
No apply commits a message describing nothing that apply landed.
The message an apply that committed nothing composed is lost, because no commit holds it.
The rows an apply lands are handed in.
An apply handed no rows refuses rather than reading edits off disk.
An apply stating no read is judged against the commit at HEAD.
A read the caller states is judged against instead of the commit at HEAD.
A read older than HEAD catches every move the commit at HEAD catches.
A move the caller names is handed to the landing the apply makes.
A move handed in beside the rows is handed on beside the caller's moves.
An apply is judged by the gate as any other landing is judged.
An apply told to measure marks the run so the tests are held to no ceiling.
That mark is taken off however the apply ended.
A measuring apply the gate cleared is refused.
A measure lands nothing.
A body a row leaves is formatted before the gate judges that body.
A body the formatter moved is named in the answer.
An apply with a manifest has the lockfile those manifests warrant.
An apply writes a page type's worked type again as any other landing does.
A link the landing placed is named in the report.
A link the landing could not place is answered as a refusal beside the commit.
An apply with a manifest installs the checkout onto the commit that apply landed.
An install the apply's tree would not take is answered as the landing road answers that install.
A reading is recorded of the body the formatter left rather than the body drafted.
A reading never ages out.
A wiped record leaves an apply unwarranted.
A reading is recorded again from the body at HEAD for every path the apply writes.
The change was replayed onto that body.
That body is the body the writer worked on where every row anchors in a passage read.
A row rewriting a whole body anchors in a passage read as that row was composed.
A reading recorded again over such a row warrants a body the writer never read.
`module/change-freshness` admits such a row.
That body is the body the writer worked on.
A path the base commit did not have has no body to have been read.
A reading is recorded before the gate runs.
An apply the gate refused leaves those readings recorded.
A body an apply lands is recorded as read by the agent that called the apply.
An agent is never left owing a read of the bodies that agent's own apply landed.
A body a row appended to is recorded as read by nobody.
A body a row brought in is recorded as read by nobody.
A body going away is recorded as read by nobody.
A landing naming no agent records nothing as read.
A landing is held to a reading the caller already has.
A path the caller has no reading of is left out rather than made up.
An apply whose rows owe their readers no reading carries those readings onto the bodies applied.
An apply whose rows owe their readers a reading carries no reading.
A reading is carried and dropped before the applying agent's own reading is recorded.
A path a move renamed has the reading of the body that path came from.
Nothing is applied where no rows are handed in.
An apply over rows that are mechanical runs no check.
Why no check ran is said in the commit only where the glass was broken.
An apply over rows that are not mechanical is judged as any authored apply is.
An apply that was refused carries what the mechanisms said while the change was prepared.
What those mechanisms said is reported rather than refused.
An apply that landed carries those same sayings.
Every refusal an apply answers with is written beside the calling agent's page.
A run replaces those refusals rather than appending to those refusals.
An apply that landed leaves no refusals beside that page.
A refusal set past what one answer has is answered as a pointer to that agent's file.
Where those refusals are written is worked out by the module keeping them.
A hold held past its ceiling is answered as a refusal rather than thrown on.
An apply exits with the code the landing that apply ran refused with.
An apply the checks refused exits as a fault of the data.
An apply a hold held past its ceiling exits as an operational fault.
An apply handed no rows exits as a fault of the call.
An apply whose checks would not load exits as an operational fault.
An apply a fault after the commit went wrong for exits as an operational fault.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
Nothing here takes the hold.
An apply whose commit landed answers with that commit however the work after it went.
A fault thrown after the commit is answered as a refusal beside that commit.
The commit such a refusal names is read from a slot rather than off a list.
A key an apply does not take is refused rather than passed over.

definition: the rows an agent has answered landed onto the tree as one commit
